correctness.rationale: Equal unit values force q-sized bundles. Every mixed induced biclique is (1,2)- and (2,1)-compact and is (1,1)-compact exactly when one part has size one. Summing labeled multinomial assignments proves both exact formulas, and Fourier inversion of the centered {−1,0,1} distribution with variance 4/7 proves the sharp (4/7)^n rate. The independent graph-distance enumeration agreed across 1,506,716 equitable allocations in 51 tests; this finite verification supplements, not replaces, the universal proof.
